Reasoning:
Success for this subtask means: (1) the gripper remains closed/grasping cube_1 throughout the lowering motion; (2) the tool orientation is maintained with tool +z antiparallel to world +z (top-down configuration); (3) the tool frame origin (panda_fingertip) reaches the target height of cube_2 center + 0.05 m along world +z (= cube_2 half-height 0.025 m + cube_1 half-height 0.025 m above cube_2 center), placing cube_1 bottom face flush on cube_2 top face.

Constraint 1 — close_gripper [gripper_closed]: The subtask explicitly requires both gripper fingers to remain closed (finger state ≈ 0.0) throughout the entire lowering motion to maintain the grasp on cube_1.

Constraint 2 — axis_align [geometry]: The subtask requires tool +z in agent frame to remain antiparallel to world +z (top-down configuration from prior grasp). axis_align with controlled_axis="+z", reference_axis="+z", alignment="antiparallel" encodes this orientation requirement. This also captures the "apply zero angular velocity / orientation fixed" requirement.

Constraint 3 — reach_point [geometry, manipulator_high_effort]: The primary stop condition (4a) is reaching within 0.01 m of the target height (cube_2 center z + 0.05 m). This is encoded as reach_point to cube_2 origin + offset [0, 0, 0.05] in world basis, with tolerance_m=0.01. The manipulator_high_effort condition tag captures the alternative stop condition (4b): if effort feedback on the gripper fingers rises above free-space levels indicating cube_1 has made contact with cube_2 top face, motion should also stop. The OR between position and effort stop conditions cannot be fully expressed as separate OR-branched constraints without a dedicated effort-only op in the TermAPI; the effort condition is therefore captured as metadata on this constraint. The grasp-loss monitoring (constraint 6) is captured by the gripper_closed condition on close_gripper — if effort drops indicating loss of grasp, the close_gripper constraint would no longer be satisfied, signaling halt.
